brief:
The Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem ordained four new deacons on Saturday, November 21, with Bishop Rafic Nahra, Patriarchal Vicar for Israel, presiding over the ceremony at Domus Galilaeae. The ordination took place on the eve of the Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe.

The new deacons join the church's clergy ahead of the liturgical year's major feast day. The Latin Patriarchate, based in Jerusalem, oversees Catholic communities across the region.
